scope: Published archive inventory and selected-run observations; not a fixed-cohort benchmark.

definitions.archiveRecord: One catalog entry with its own statement and provenance. Entries may contain several targets or support/conditional results.
definitions.selection: The 16 project-verified records were selected for publication after passing. Their 45 saved runs are histories of those selected problems, not an evaluation denominator.
definitions.projectVerification: The recorded Lean kernel and original comparator passed; OpenAI-hosted evaluation remains unconfirmed.
definitions.modelLabel: The original catalog label, not an independently reconstructed per-call model history.
definitions.selectedRunDurationSeconds: finishedAt minus startedAt for verification.runId. This is a saved interval for that run, not from-scratch or total proof-production time.
definitions.reportedUsage: The exact counters stored on the selected result, supplied by the source observations. These are not complete proof-production totals. usageComplete describes this run's recorded metering only.
definitions.recordedLaunchBudget: The saved launch limits for the selected result. A value of zero means unlimited. These are not common limits across all attempts or continuations.
definitions.sourceHashes: Public source-file hashes are recomputed here. Original result/launch hashes identify privately retained source artifacts inspected for the observations; this script does not independently reproduce their counters.
definitions.unfinishedSnapshot: A historical saved research state. Its phase and turn count do not describe a currently live run.
definitions.null: Not established for this scope. Null is not zero usage, zero cost, or an unlimited budget. CSV represents null with an empty cell.

fieldProvenance.officialPasses: accepted/accepted.json plus submitted/official-results.json, bound to submitted/submitted.json by submission_manifest_sha256
fieldProvenance.projectVerification: data/proofs/{id}/verification.json and the matching Submission.lean SHA-256
fieldProvenance.runs: data/proofs/{id}/process.json; the selected run is matched by verification.runId
